About Us

Welcome to Luxe Gloss

Leave the stress behind. Luxe Gloss & Spa was born from the belief that true beauty is not perfected — it is revealed. Inspired by wabi-sabi, we honour the natural, the weathered and the quietly lovely in every ritual we offer.

From our exclusive children’s salon to our upstairs massage suites, we bring the whole family a one-stop experience of beauty and wellness. Our therapists are trained to balance wellness with artistry, so every visit leaves you remembered and renewed.
